author: AsapSCIENCE
description:
Peptides are extremely popular right now. They are injectable short chain amino acids that claim to make people healthier, heal from injury and live longer. Science is now finding that they could cause cancer, and maybe result in early death. So what is going on with peptides? Are influencers ruining science? 

Written by: Gregory Brown

Edited by: Luka Šarlija
